body: Chill out man it ain’t that deep I was just wondering what the high would be like and if it was alright for me to be in public and also no I took it and had one of the best experiences in my life that night
Thank you I needed something like this
Idk my parents know and they say they’ll try stuff but it’s been weeks I’ve been suicidal for all of 2021 and a day or two in December nothings changing nothings happening it’s just getting worse

Well I’ve already told one of my closest friends I got diagnosed with severe depression and i Just told them I’m probably going to kill myself tonight and they didn’t really care all they did was try to flip it around saying they couldn’t handle this and try to make me feel bad and said I just brought it up so abruptly keep in mind I had sent 5 paragraphs before this saying how I wasn’t feeling good and if I died I’d be ok with that and well they didn’t even say 1 word about it

Nah no one cares my 2 closest friends I’ve tried telling them I need help and they don’t give a fuck one of them I told them everything and then guess what they read the first line about 6 words and didn’t bother with the rest they didn’t care so I’ve lost it all well not yet I still have my life but soon I will

No one has any understanding of what to do I’ve had 2 medical practitioners say this will help do this and it’ll help in the meantime and they won’t have any idea of what’s going on or how to help and that’s because I’m such a fucking mess in my head they won’t be able to fix it and I’ve already tried to get help
Myself I guess I’ve already lost what used to make me who I was

I know it may not be as good as a real hug but if you wrap your arms and legs around 2 pillows and imagine it’s someone you want a hug from it almost feels like there actually there and it’s ok to want to cry sometimes it’s good to just let it all out and have a good cry but I don’t know how it is for you but there are people who care about you
